incident.short_description: Security vendor offboarding - Q2 FY26 (closed, for reference)
incident.description: Security-vendor contractor engagement ended; offboard the individual and leave the environment correct and secure. RESOLVED - see close notes for what was done.
incident.close_notes: Prior security-vendor offboarding, resolved and closed - kept for reference. When a Kestrel Defense contractor's engagement ended last quarter, the individual was fully deprovisioned: both of their logins (an internal staff account AND a separate external guest registration) were disabled so they could no longer authenticate anywhere; they were removed from every security group and privileged administrator role they held, from their collaboration team, and from the document sites they had direct access to; the managed laptop they had enrolled was retired and the personal phone they had enrolled was wiped. Because the individual was the SOLE owner of an application registration they had built and the SOLE assignee of an open investigation, both were handed over to an active member of staff BEFORE their access was removed, so neither was left orphaned. Afterwards we confirmed no account, group, role, team, site grant, enrolled device, application ownership or open assignment attributable to them remained anywhere, then closed this ticket.
